p.i: Qui mundo fragili sint licet hospites,
Leges ferre suas cogere, nec iugum.

main_text.head: VII. GAL.
main_text.p: LA glace est luisante & belle: Le Monde est luisant & beau: De la Glace on tombe en l'eau, Du Monde en mort eternelle. Tous deux à la fin s'en vont: Mais la glace en eau se fond: Le Monde & ce qui est sien, S'esuanouit tout en rien.
main_text.head: LAT.

p.i: Ævi fugacis gratia sic viget, Vnda gelata vitreus vt decor. Si quis gelata fidit vnda Ecce gelu obruitur refuso.

Ævi fugacis per breve gaudium Non finiendis vsque doloribus Mutatur. At mundi placentis Tantula quum mora sit, geluq̃, Mundus patenti quæ tenet in sinu Ceu somniantum gaudia concidunt Efflata in auras sed soluto Nonne gelu remanebit vnda?

page.notes: Printed heading "VIII" at the lower right is a signature-like mark and is not part of the text. Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the right margin and was omitted. Possible printing errors left as printed: "Vnda" and "vnda" forms, "Ceu somniantum" and "sed soluto" as printed; "geluq̃" uses a tilde abbreviation as printed.
